name: Al Wakeel
description: Allah is sufficient for those who entrust their affairs to Him.
summary: The name implies that Allah is the ultimate protector and guardian of His creation, handling all matters and ensuring they are done justly and in accordance with His wisdom. The name Al Wakeel is derived from the Arabic root 'w-k-l', which means 'to appoint, to designate, or to entrust'. It appears in Islamic texts and emphasizes the reliance of creation on Allah's management.
